headword: {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}
gloss: service life; useful life; durability period

definitions.gloss: service life; useful life; expected lifespan (of equipment or assets)
definitions.explanation: The expected number of years that equipment, buildings, or other assets can be used before needing replacement. Used both in everyday contexts and in accounting for depreciation purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧だ。
examples.english: This machine has a service life of ten years.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioner exceeded its service life, so I replaced it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税法|ぜいほう}→税法：27440_zeihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められた→定める：10448_sadameru⟧{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}→減価償却：30207_genkashoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Depreciation is calculated based on the service life defined in the tax code.

notes:
A practical term for the expected useful lifespan of equipment and assets. Composed of {耐用|たいよう} (durable use) + ⟦{年数|ねんすう}→年数：23485_nensuu⟧ (number of years). Used in everyday conversations about appliances and in business/accounting for calculating depreciation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to exceed service life
- {法定|ほうてい}{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}: legally mandated service life
- {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to surpass service life
- {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧/⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧: long/short service life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧: lifespan — used for people, animals, and products
- ⟦{使用期限|しようきげん}→使用期限：22047_shiyoukigen⟧: expiration date, use-by date — for consumables
- ⟦{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}→耐久性：20042_taikyuusei⟧: durability — the quality of lasting
- ⟦{減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}→減価償却：30207_genkashoukyaku⟧: depreciation — the accounting method that uses {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}
